name: Honghu-03
location_str: Launch Area 96B @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Note: Second test launch of LandSpace’s ZQ-3 rocket and first ever successful orbital launch vehicle booster recovery by a Chinese private launch service provider.  Prototype LEO communication satellite for LandSpace's subsidiary Hongqing Technology.
slot_b_text: ZQ-3 F2 is a brand new core. Perfect 1 for 1 on landings. Down on ZQ-3 LZ, 390 km downrange.
